findings: Blue and white vitreous enamel sign 'LEADING NEWSPAPER. THE DAILY TELEGRAPH. TASMANIA.' with 'MADE IN ENGLAND' at lower right. condition: Large enamel loss and rust to top right corner with a jagged edge, chips at fixing holes and edges, reverse heavily rusted. Face otherwise bright and glossy.
reason: Rare pre-1928 Launceston Daily Telegraph enamel sign, strong Tasmanian advertising collector appeal despite corner loss
